018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.FileUtils.resolveVirtualPathSafely;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
021import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.StringUtils.*;
022
023import java.io.*;
024import java.util.*;
025
026import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;
027import org.apache.juneau.http.response.*;
028import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.*;

030
031import com.github.mustachejava.*;
032import com.github.mustachejava.resolver.*;

034/**
035 * Flavor-neutral worker bean carrying the Mustache raw-template-dispatch logic shared by the
036 * {@link MustacheMixin} mixin, the {@link MustacheServlet} servlet, and the {@link MustacheResource}
037 * child flavors.
038 *
039 * <p>
040 * This is the <i>flavor-neutral worker</i> for the Mustache capability: it is <b>not</b> one
041 * of the three {@code @Rest} flavor classes &mdash; it is a plain bean that implements
042 * {@link RawTemplateDispatcher} and holds the capability state ({@code basePath} /
043 * {@code templateSuffix} / lazy default factory) plus the raw-serve and factory-resolution logic.
044 * Each flavor independently holds an instance of this worker and delegates to it, so no flavor is
045 * another flavor's worker.
046 *
047 * <h2 class='section'>See Also:</h2><ul>
048 *    <li class='jc'>{@link MustacheMixin}
049 *    <li class='jc'>{@link MustacheServlet}
050 *    <li class='jc'>{@link MustacheResource}
051 *    <li class='jic'>{@link RawTemplateDispatcher}
052 * </ul>
053 *
054 * @since 10.0.0
055 */
056@SuppressWarnings({
057   "resource" // Closeables here are framework-managed and not owned/closed by this class; not a real leak.
058})
059public class MustacheDispatcher implements RawTemplateDispatcher {
060
061   /** Default base path applied when no {@link Builder#basePath(String)} call has been made. */
062   @SuppressWarnings({
063      "java:S1075" // Default for the configurable basePath setting, not a hardcoded location.
064   })
065   public static final String DEFAULT_BASE_PATH = "/templates/";
066
067   /** Default template suffix &mdash; empty (literal template names, no implicit suffix). */
068   public static final String DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_SUFFIX = "";
069
070   /** Default cache-templates setting &mdash; {@code true} (cache forever; production-safe). */
071   public static final boolean DEFAULT_CACHE_TEMPLATES = true;
072
073   private final String basePath;
074   private final String templateSuffix;
075   private final boolean cacheTemplates;
076
077   // Lazy bridge-default factory. Built on first call to resolveMustacheFactory(...) when no
078   // MustacheFactory bean is registered in the request's BeanStore. Held in an AtomicReference so the
079   // double-checked-locking idiom is safe under concurrent first-request load.
080   private final AtomicReference<MustacheFactory> defaultFactory = new AtomicReference<>();
081
082   /**
083    * Creates a new builder.
084    *
085    * @return A new builder.
086    */
087   public static Builder create() {
088      return new Builder();
089   }
090
091   /**
092    * Builder constructor.
093    *
094    * @param builder The builder. Must not be {@code null}.
095    */
096   protected MustacheDispatcher(Builder builder) {
097      basePath = builder.basePath;
098      templateSuffix = builder.templateSuffix;
099      cacheTemplates = builder.cacheTemplates;
100   }
101
102   /**
103    * Returns the base path under which template resources are resolved.
104    *
105    * @return The base path. Never {@code null}.
106    */
107   public String getBasePath() {
108      return basePath;
109   }
110
111   /**
112    * Returns the configured template-name suffix.
113    *
114    * @return The template suffix. Never {@code null}.
115    */
116   public String getTemplateSuffix() {
117      return templateSuffix;
118   }
119
120   /**
121    * Returns whether the bridge-default {@link MustacheFactory} caches compiled templates.
122    *
123    * @return The cache flag. Defaults to {@link #DEFAULT_CACHE_TEMPLATES}.
124    */
125   public boolean isCacheTemplates() {
126      return cacheTemplates;
127   }
128
129   /**
130    * The extension of the templates this bridge serves: the configured {@link #getTemplateSuffix() templateSuffix}, or
131    * {@code ".mustache"} when no suffix is configured.
132    */
133   String servedExtension() {
134      return isEmpty(templateSuffix) ? ".mustache" : templateSuffix;
135   }
136
137   /**
138    * Appends {@link #getTemplateSuffix()} to {@code name} if not already present (idempotent).
139    *
140    * @param name The template name. Must not be {@code null}.
141    * @return The template name with the configured suffix appended (if applicable).
142    */
143   public String applyTemplateSuffix(String name) {
144      if (isEmpty(templateSuffix))
145         return name;
146      if (name.endsWith(templateSuffix))
147         return name;
148      return name + templateSuffix;
149   }
150
151   /**
152    * Resolves the active {@link MustacheFactory}.
153    *
154    * <p>
155    * Lookup order:
156    * <ol class='spaced-list'>
157    *    <li>{@code req.getContext().getBeanStore().getBean(MustacheFactory.class)} &mdash; any
158    *       user-supplied bean (Spring {@code @Bean}, microservice {@code BasicBeanStore.put},
159    *       etc.). Never cached or rebuilt by this bridge &mdash; {@link #isCacheTemplates()} does
160    *       not apply to user-supplied factories.
161    *    <li>Bridge default &mdash; a {@link DefaultMustacheFactory} anchored on a resource root
162    *       derived from {@link #getBasePath() basePath} (leading + trailing slashes trimmed).
163    *       When {@link #isCacheTemplates()} is {@code true} (the default), a single instance is
164    *       lazily built once and reused (mustache.java's own {@code DefaultMustacheFactory}
165    *       compiles-and-caches templates internally, so reuse means "compile once"). When
166    *       {@code false}, a fresh factory with an empty compile-cache is built on every call, so
167    *       every render recompiles the template from its current classpath contents (hot-reload).
168    * </ol>
169    *
170    * @param req The current REST request.
171    * @return The active Mustache factory. Never {@code null}.
172    */
173   public MustacheFactory resolveMustacheFactory(RestRequest req) {
174      var bean = req.getContext().getBeanStore().getBean(MustacheFactory.class);
175      if (bean.isPresent())
176         return bean.get();
177      if (! cacheTemplates)
178         return buildDefaultFactory();
179      var local = defaultFactory.get();
180      if (local == null) {
181         synchronized (this) {
182            local = defaultFactory.get();
183            if (local == null) {
184               local = buildDefaultFactory();
185               defaultFactory.set(local);
186            }
187         }
188      }
189      return local;
190   }
191
192   /**
193    * Constructs the bridge-default {@link MustacheFactory}.
194    *
195    * <p>
196    * {@link DefaultMustacheFactory} anchored on a classpath resource root derived from
197    * {@link #getBasePath() basePath} (leading + trailing slashes trimmed). A {@code "/"} base
198    * yields a no-prefix factory. Subclasses may override to plug in custom resolvers / object
199    * handlers without registering a separate {@code @Bean MustacheFactory}.
200    *
201    * @return A new {@link MustacheFactory} instance.
202    */
203   protected MustacheFactory buildDefaultFactory() {
204      var root = toResourceRoot(basePath);
205      // Classpath-only resolver: no URI or file-system resolution of template or partial names.
206      return new DefaultMustacheFactory(root.isEmpty() ? new ClasspathResolver() : new ClasspathResolver(root));
207   }
208
209   /**
210    * Translates a virtual base path (e.g. {@code "/templates/"}) into a mustache.java resource
211    * root (e.g. {@code "templates"}).
212    *
213    * <p>
214    * mustache.java's {@link DefaultMustacheFactory#DefaultMustacheFactory(String)} expects a
215    * classpath-relative root without a leading slash and treats a trailing slash as part of the
216    * resolved path, so we trim both ends. A {@code null} / blank / {@code "/"} base yields an
217    * empty string &mdash; meaning "no prefix" (factory resolves names directly).
218    *
219    * @param base The virtual base path.
220    * @return The mustache.java resource root (never {@code null}).
221    */
222   static String toResourceRoot(String base) {
223      if (isBlank(base))
224         return "";
225      var s = base;
226      while (s.startsWith("/"))
227         s = s.substring(1);
228      while (s.endsWith("/"))
229         s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 1);
230      return s;
231   }
232
233   /**
234    * Renders a raw template through the Mustache engine onto the response.
235    *
236    * @param path The trailing path segment after the mount prefix (the template name relative to
237    *    the configured {@link #getBasePath() base path}; configured suffix appended if missing).
238    * @param req The current REST request.
239    * @param res The current REST response.
240    * @throws IOException If the underlying response writer fails.
241    * @throws BasicHttpException On boundary violation (403), missing engine (500), or render
242    *    failure (500).
243    */
244   @Override /* RawTemplateDispatcher */
245   public void render(String path, RestRequest req, RestResponse res)
246         throws IOException, BasicHttpException {
247
248      var template = (path == null) ? "" : path;
249
250      // resolveVirtualPathSafely validates that the resolved virtual path stays inside the
251      // configured basePath. The traversal check operates on basePath + template so a template
252      // name like "../../etc/passwd" or "a/b/../../../secret" is rejected before reaching the
253      // engine. We re-derive the factory-relative template name from the safe result by
254      // stripping the (already-normalized) basePath prefix.
255      String safeTemplate;
256      try {
257         var resolved = resolveVirtualPathSafely(basePath, template);
258         safeTemplate = stripBasePath(basePath, resolved);
259      } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
260         throw new Forbidden("Path escapes configured base path.");
261      }
262
263      // Apply suffix idempotently so /mustache/about resolves to about.mustache (when
264      // templateSuffix is configured), while /mustache/about.mustache stays as-is.
265      safeTemplate = applyTemplateSuffix(safeTemplate);
266
267      // Only template-extension names are served, and names carrying a scheme or backslash never are.
268      if (! ViewTemplateNames.isPlainName(safeTemplate) || ! ViewTemplateNames.hasAllowedExtension(safeTemplate, servedExtension()))
269         throw new NotFound("Template not found.");
270
271      try {
272         var factory = resolveMustacheFactory(req);
273         if (! res.containsHeader("Content-Type"))
274            res.setHeader("Content-Type", MustacheViewRenderer.DEFAULT_CONTENT_TYPE);
275         var mustache = factory.compile(safeTemplate);
276         mustache.execute(res.getWriter(), Map.of()).flush();
277      } catch (LinkageError ex) {
278         throw new InternalServerError(ex, MustacheViewRenderer.NO_ENGINE_DIAGNOSTIC);
279      } catch (IOException | BasicHttpException ex) {
280         throw ex;
281      } catch (Exception ex) {
282         throw new InternalServerError(ex, "Mustache render failed for '%s'", safeTemplate);
283      }
284   }
285
286   /**
287    * Strips the normalized {@code basePath} prefix from a {@code resolveVirtualPathSafely}
288    * result so the leftover string is factory-relative (the bridge's default factory re-adds
289    * the configured resource-root prefix).
290    *
291    * <p>
292    * Normalization mirrors {@code FileUtils.resolveVirtualPathSafely}: a {@code null} / empty
293    * base normalizes to {@code "/"}; otherwise the base is guaranteed to start with {@code "/"}
294    * and end with {@code "/"} once the helper has normalized it.
295    *
296    * @param base The configured base path (typically {@code "/templates/"}).
297    * @param resolved The output of {@code resolveVirtualPathSafely} (always starts with the
298    *    normalized base).
299    * @return The factory-relative template name (e.g. {@code "hello.mustache"} for base
300    *    {@code "/templates/"} and resolved {@code "/templates/hello.mustache"}).
301    */
302   static String stripBasePath(String base, String resolved) {
303      var bp = isEmpty(base) ? "/" : base;
304      if (! bp.endsWith("/"))
305         bp = bp + "/";
306      if (! bp.startsWith("/"))
307         bp = "/" + bp;
308      if (resolved.startsWith(bp))
309         return resolved.substring(bp.length());
310      throw iaex("Resolved path '%s' does not start with base '%s'", resolved, bp);
311   }
312
313   /**
314    * Builder for {@link MustacheDispatcher}.
315    */
316   public static class Builder {
317
318      String basePath = DEFAULT_BASE_PATH;
319      String templateSuffix = DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_SUFFIX;
320      boolean cacheTemplates = DEFAULT_CACHE_TEMPLATES;
321
322      /** Constructor &mdash; package access for {@link MustacheDispatcher#create()}. */
323      protected Builder() {}
324
325      /**
326       * Sets the classpath base path under which template resources are resolved.
327       *
328       * @param value The base path. {@code null} or blank values reset to the default
329       *    {@link MustacheDispatcher#DEFAULT_BASE_PATH}.
330       * @return This object.
331       */
332      public Builder basePath(String value) {
333         basePath = isBlank(value) ? DEFAULT_BASE_PATH : value;
334         return this;
335      }
336
337      /**
338       * Sets the suffix to append to template names that don't already end with it (idempotent).
339       *
340       * @param value The new suffix. {@code null} resets to
341       *    {@link MustacheDispatcher#DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_SUFFIX}.
342       * @return This object.
343       */
344      public Builder templateSuffix(String value) {
345         templateSuffix = (value == null) ? DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_SUFFIX : value;
346         return this;
347      }
348
349      /**
350       * Sets whether the bridge-default {@link MustacheFactory} caches compiled templates.
351       *
352       * <p>
353       * Defaults to {@link MustacheDispatcher#DEFAULT_CACHE_TEMPLATES true} (cache
354       * forever &mdash; production-safe). Set {@code false} to enable dev hot-reload (every
355       * render rebuilds the factory from a fresh, empty compile-cache).
356       *
357       * <p>
358       * This flag only affects the bridge-default factory; a user-supplied
359       * {@code @Bean MustacheFactory} is not modified.
360       *
361       * @param value The cache flag.
362       * @return This object.
363       */
364      public Builder cacheTemplates(boolean value) {
365         cacheTemplates = value;
366         return this;
367      }
368
369      /**
370       * Reads the current base path setting (test/inspection helper).
371       *
372       * @return The base path. Never {@code null}.
373       */
374      public String getBasePath() {
375         return basePath;
376      }
377
378      /**
379       * Reads the current template-suffix setting (test/inspection helper).
380       *
381       * @return The template suffix. Never {@code null}.
382       */
383      public String getTemplateSuffix() {
384         return templateSuffix;
385      }
386
387      /**
388       * Reads the current cache-templates setting (test/inspection helper).
389       *
390       * @return The cache flag.
391       */
392      public boolean isCacheTemplates() {
393         return cacheTemplates;
394      }
395
396      /**
397       * Builds the {@link MustacheDispatcher}.
398       *
399       * @return A new {@link MustacheDispatcher} instance.
400       */
401      public MustacheDispatcher build() {
402         if (basePath == null)
403            throw iaex("basePath must not be null");
404         return new MustacheDispatcher(this);
405      }
406   }
407}
